text_blocks.snippet: Common side effects of Losartan include dizziness, fatigue, nasal congestion, back pain, and mild stomach upset.
snippet_highlighted_words: dizziness, fatigue, nasal congestion, back pain, and mild stomach upset

list.snippet: Dizziness or lightheadedness: Happens when your blood pressure drops, especially upon standing up quickly.
Fatigue: Feeling more tired than usual as your body adjusts to lower blood pressure.
Upper respiratory symptoms: Stuffy nose, sinus congestion, or cold-like symptoms.
Aches and pains: Back pain or occasional joint pain.
Digestive changes: Mild nausea, vomiting, or diarrhea.
Headaches: Often temporary when first starting the medication.
High potassium levels (Hyperkalemia): Can cause muscle weakness or irregular heartbeats, requiring routine blood tests.
Kidney function changes: May unmask or worsen kidney issues; signs include changes in urination or swelling in the legs.
Severe low blood pressure (Hypotension): Causes fainting, extreme lightheadedness, or confusion.
Angioedema: A rare, life-threatening allergic reaction causing swelling of the face, lips, tongue, or throat.
Fetal harm: Losartan must be avoided during pregnancy as it can cause serious injury or death to an unborn baby.
